name: 98433 · Jblm, WA
findings: ZIP 98433 (Jblm) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98433 (Jblm) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
